title: AffordanceWAM: Affordance-Aware Joint World-Action Modeling for Robot Manipulation
author: Jiadi You, Qize Yu, Yue Chen, Minghong Cai et al.

summary: Generalizable robot manipulation requires predicting how a scene will evolve, identifying where interactions are feasible, and determining how to act. Action-labeled robot videos directly supervise control but are costly and limited in diversity, whereas egocentric human videos capture diverse interactions but lack robot actions and differ in embodiment and appearance.
takeaways: We introduce AffordanceWAM, an affordance-aware generative World Action Model that represents object-centric spatiotemporal affordance through Scalar Affordance and Affordance Heatmap, within the generated future World.
Under fixed robot supervision, RoboCasa performance improves monotonically as affordance-annotated human video scales.
These results support affordance as an effective interface for both vision-language-action learning and human-to-robot transfer.
